bands.rationale: Small post YC round of about $1M to $3M, often angels and a micro fund. Window based: only a round above about $1M from outside investors that closes inside the window counts, the standard YC deal of about $500K does not. Bands follow the 2022+ seed table (p25 $2.8M, median $4.1M, p75 $6.5M) split into small post YC, institutional and hot seeds.

Institutional seed of $3M to $6M, the common case. Window based: only a round above about $1M from outside investors that closes inside the window counts, the standard YC deal of about $500K does not. Bands follow the 2022+ seed table (p25 $2.8M, median $4.1M, p75 $6.5M) split into small post YC, institutional and hot seeds.

Larger institutional seed of $6M to $12M after fast early traction. Window based: only a round above about $1M from outside investors that closes inside the window counts, the standard YC deal of about $500K does not. Bands follow the 2022+ seed table (p25 $2.8M, median $4.1M, p75 $6.5M) split into small post YC, institutional and hot seeds.

Hot seed above $12M, up to about $25M, for an unusually strong story. Window based: only a round above about $1M from outside investors that closes inside the window counts, the standard YC deal of about $500K does not. Bands follow the 2022+ seed table (p25 $2.8M, median $4.1M, p75 $6.5M) split into small post YC, institutional and hot seeds.
Thin Series A of $6M to $10M at a modest valuation, below the 2022+ median. Series A bands use the 2022+ YC table (p25 $11M, median $15M, p75 $21M) and public medians of about $17M.
Typical Series A of $10M to $20M, near the 2022+ YC median of about $14M. Series A bands use the 2022+ YC table (p25 $11M, median $15M, p75 $21M) and public medians of about $17M.
Strong Series A of $20M to $40M for a fast growing product with revenue. Series A bands use the 2022+ YC table (p25 $11M, median $15M, p75 $21M) and public medians of about $17M.
Flat or down style Series B of $15M to $30M. Series B bands use the 2022+ YC table (p25 $27M, median $40M, p75 $55M); few YC companies reach it.
Typical Series B of $30M to $60M, near the 2022+ median of about $40M. Series B bands use the 2022+ YC table (p25 $27M, median $40M, p75 $55M); few YC companies reach it.
Upside Series B of $60M to $120M. Series B bands use the 2022+ YC table (p25 $27M, median $40M, p75 $55M); few YC companies reach it.
Smaller growth round of $30M to $70M. Series C and later bands use the 2022+ YC table (Series C median $74M, Series D plus $150M); small samples.
Typical Series C of $70M to $150M. Series C and later bands use the 2022+ YC table (Series C median $74M, Series D plus $150M); small samples.
Large late round above $150M. Series C and later bands use the 2022+ YC table (Series C median $74M, Series D plus $150M); small samples.
